title: Docker: container page
question: Which container page do you prefer? (Tabs work)

variants.label: Tabs
variants.notes: Overview, Logs, Stats, Shell, Inspect, Settings as tabs. Overview shows live charts, container facts, ports, mounts and environment (secrets hidden). Header in all: state, health, stack link, update available, Pause/Stop/Restart. Tabs are clickable.

variants.label: Logs first
variants.notes: Live charts as a strip on top, live logs take the main column with search and highlighted warnings and errors; Shell and Inspect as tabs next to Logs. Facts, ports, mounts and env stay visible on the right. Header in all: state, health, stack link, update available, Pause/Stop/Restart. Tabs are clickable.

variants.label: Everything at once
variants.notes: Bigger charts on top, logs and shell side by side, details in folding sections at the bottom. Good on a wide screen. Header in all: state, health, stack link, update available, Pause/Stop/Restart. Tabs are clickable.
